title: Ivanka Trump on Chanukah
body: Ivanka Trump reflects on Chanukah's spiritual themes, calling for moral clarity, compassion, and light in the wake of a Sydney terror attack.

title: Bondi Beach Mass Shooting
body: Australia's deadliest firearms attack in decades occurred at Bondi Beach, where a Chanukah celebration turned deadly. Police believe a father and son, who legally owned multiple guns, carried out the assault.
